== Game Abilities ==
=== Basic Abilities ===
*Amplify
*Interference
*Shielding
=== Abilities ===
*'''Amplify'''
**Each time Blaster uses a Special Attack he gains an Amp Charge up to a maximum of 10 charges.
**Sonic Attacks used in Blaster’s Basic Ranged and Special Attacks deal 5~6% more damage for each Amp Charge on Blaster.
*'''Basic Ranged Attacks'''
**70~80% chance to inflict Interference, lowering Ranged Damage by 10~20% and decreasing Projectile Speed for 10 seconds.
*'''Heavy Attack'''
**100% chance to inflict Shock, dealing 30% of Attack over 5 seconds.
**Shocks are 20% stronger for each Amp Charge on Blaster.
*'''Blocking'''
**Activates a Shield, reducing incoming Damage by 6~15% while holding Block for 0.5 seconds and for 0.2 seconds once released.
**Blaster’s Shield lasts 50% longer for each Amp Charge on him.

=== Signature Abillity ===
'''Absorption Shield'''

''Blaster’s Shielding system can be upgraded to absorb incoming energy attacks and repair damage. A similar upgrade was requested by his fellow Autobots for their audio receptors as an answer to his taste in music.''

*While Shielded: Blaster’s Shield allows him to shrug off the impact of Basic Energy Ranged Attacks and reduces a further 20% of incoming Energy Damage. Additionally Energy Attacks that hit Blaster while his Shielding is up have a 40% chance to instantly Repair Blaster for 7~17% of the opponent’s Attack Rating. If the attack is a Special Attack he repairs double that amount instead.

=== Special Attacks ===

#*100% chance to inflict an Attack Debuff reducing the Opponent’s Attack Rating by 10% for 20 seconds. Blaster then inflicts an additional Attack Debuff for each Amp Charge on him.
=== Synergy Bonuses ===
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Allies – [[Ultra Magnus]], [[Arcee]]''' - +2~3~8% Armor.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Enemies – [[Soundwave]], [[Tantrum]], [[Cyclonus]]''' - +2~3~8% Attack Rating.
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Shield Amp – Soundwave, [[Mirage]], [[Rhinox]]''' - 1.5~4~10% Damage Reduction while Shielded.
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Brain Drain – [[Shockwave]]''' - Shockwave generates 1~2~3 Energy Charges at the start of the fight and every 25 seconds.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Brain Gain – Shockwave''' - 10~15~25% Increase to Attack against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only gets this benefit if all bots on his team have this synergy.
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - +10% Power Rate for all lower tier teammates.
== Strategy ==

=== Player ===
For longer battles, "amp-it-up" by using Special 1 three times for maximum amp charges. He is great against Bots with powerful ranged attacks. Keep the opponent's ranged attack speed down by constantly shooting; Interference is inflicted any time the projectiles are close to the opponent . After inflicting some interference, try counter-shooting after sidestepping slowed opponent projectiles.

His absorption shield is not practical for sustainable repair and survivability, as he will still take damage from energy attacks even if absorbed.

=== Opponent ===
Melee bots such as [[Optimus Primal]] or [[Tantrum]] will take down the noisy Autobot. Also, try not to get hit by his basic ranged attacks. You don't want your shots to be slowed to a halt.

If this boombox gets to Special II, block or Sidestep as soon as possible - this attack, much like [[Shockwave]] and [[Prowl]]'s Special II, is a hard one!

(Somehow, abilities that causes Blaster's Interfering shots to Miss will still go through the Evade and cause your Bot to get inflicted with the Interference.)

=== Strong Match-ups ===
*[[Galvatron]] – Galvatron greatly relies on his Ranged Damage, something Blaster is an expert at reducing.
*[[Soundwave]] – Blaster is able to Repair himself with his own Reflected Projectiles. Let the Rivalry Begin.
*[[Waspinator]] - Disrupting where most of his damage comes from will put the Predacon bug to an end.
*[[Megatron (ROTF)]] - Blaster is the perfect counter to the decepticon leader. He drops the tunes which slow down Megatron's powered up Ranged Attacks and his specials 2 and 3 will bypass Megatron’s tough cybertronian armor. Decepticon leader, defeated by a mere autobot; exit stage right, Megs.
*[[Megatronus]]' wrath will be considerably easier to avoid if his blasts are slower.

=== Weak Match-ups ===
*[[Bumblebee]] (GS) – The little gold speedster will break through Blaster’s Shielding, inflicting Shock damage on him every time he blocks.
*[[Bludgeon]] – This tanky warrior does not use energy projectiles and will not allow Blaster to Repair when struck by his projectiles. The same goes for [[Drift]] and [[Kickback]].
*[[Kickback]] - The Insecticon is especially deadly against the Boombox. Activating special ones and heavy attacks fuel Kickback's power. 
*[[Grimlock]] - The king mostly relies on melee attacks which Blaster’s interference has no answer to and the Shock that Blaster throws will be purified.
*[[Hound]] - The military warrior relies on Precision Ammo, something Blaster's interference can't reduce as an exception.
*Other Bots who rely on melee attacks will be your friend.

=== Recommended Modules ===
Start the party with Blaster on these Mods!
*[[Laser Guidance Module]] - This module will greatly increase Blaster’s Ranged Damage and Speed, a perfect fit for a bot that can do the inverse to his opponent.
*[[Repair Module]] - The Repair Module will add to the constant Repairs he gets with his Signature Ability unlocked.
*[[Strange Refractor]]''' - '''Blaster's Interference will force the opponent to fight melee. A feat will be difficult when the strange refractor is around him.
*[[Superconductor 2000]] - Blaster's huge amped-up blast will be harder to dodge.
*[[Robot Resource]] - More power equals more specials which allow for Blaster to quickly gain amp charges. 
*[[E.M.I. Module|E.M.I Module]] - Interference will be on 24/7. (Blaster's and the mod's debuffs do not stack)

* Like Soundwave, Blaster deploys other bots during battle, namely Rewind and Steeljaw.
** Unlike Soundwave, Blaster also transforms into his boom box mode during battle (during his special 1).
